fieldValues.title: Every change is a declared stage of a known kind
fieldValues.move: Run every change to a document, including corrections and cleanups, as a Protocol stage that declares its kind (extract, update, supplement from a supplied source, restyle, classify, conform to a rule, propose a reshape, compute, gate), what it reads, the links it writes and its check; a tool computes counts and ranks, and only a person's act passes a gate.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not make a model's judgement within a stage reliable; it makes it visible, repeatable and checkable. Does not remove the cost of a person's checks.
fieldValues.falsifier: When the Party Utility backstage's 35 hand passes are recast as stages, more than a fifth of them still need a one-off script, or re-running the stages over the same inputs with another model gives a picture the organiser corrects more than the hand-built one.
fieldValues.return_when: Stage kinds multiply past what one runner can check, or a group's maintainer stops being able to read the protocol.
